title: Complete the M6 Skill action audit chain
goal: Emit an actionExecuted event for actual Skill execution attempts and link it to the resulting verified or failed observation.
context: M6's Module branch emits actionExecuted after an execution attempt, but the Skill branch emits only observationProduced. This leaves the causal audit chain incomplete for successful and failed Skill executions.
forbidden_changes: Do not emit actionExecuted when no SkillExecutionBoundary is configured and no execution was attempted.
Do not mark a Skill successful unless its receipt is verified and its Skill ID matches.
Do not change policy, capability, or cancellation behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Successful Skill execution emits actionExecuted with matching actionID, skillID, verified=true, and succeeded=true.
Failed Skill execution emits actionExecuted with succeeded=false and links to a failed observation.
The actionExecuted and observationProduced events share the same actionID.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: If the event chain fails, preserve actionID/goalID/skillID linkage and never create an actionExecuted event for an unavailable execution boundary.
